title: Hold an exploration licence
what: Hold an exploration licence (or other mining authorisation) from the state before prospecting or exploring for minerals.

sources.title: Mining Act 1992 (NSW)
sources.publisher: Official register text via the Open Australian Legal Corpus
sources.quote: A person must not prospect for or mine any mineral except in accordance with an authorisation that is in force in respect of that mineral and the land where the prospecting or mining is carried on.

assessment.summary: Exploring for minerals needs an exploration licence over a defined area, with a work program and security.

marks.reason: A licence, work program and security deposit are needed before exploring.
